services.name: Root, Trim & Blow dry short hair

reviews.author: Teresita B…
reviews.body: I have been going to Kelly for years. She’s not only very professional, but knowledgeable about hair and very helpful in helping me decide what’s best for me in terms of style and color. Kelly goes out of her way to explain how to best care for my thinning hair and how to best manage it between appointments. My hair always looks great after I have been to see her.

reviews.author: Cristina L…
reviews.body: As a Neurospicy lady, I have had the worst experiences with hair stylists here in Miami. I have fine, thinning hair and the comments have been brutal. Kelly is definitely one of a kind. Not only is she talented, but she is also warm and compassionate. I am so glad that I found a hairstylist who is perfect for my needs. 💜

reviews.author: Angie R…
reviews.body: I’ve been going to Kelly for many years, always very happy with the results.
